COMMANDS = set('''set export local . cd pwd ls ll cat echo printf touch mkdir rmdir cp mv rm ln chmod chown chgrp find grep egrep fgrep sed awk perl python python3 jq xargs tee head tail wc sort uniq cut tr xxd base64 tar gzip gunzip bzip2 xzip xz zip unzip curl wget git apt apt-get dpkg pip pip3 make cmake gcc g++ cc c++ node npm yarn pnpm ruby go rustc cargo systemctl service docker kubectl helm ssh scp rsync mount umount df du free ps kill killall nohup time env which whereis command alias unalias if then else elif fi for while until do done case esac in select function return exit true false test [ (( )) & | ! < > >> << { }'''.split())
AMBIGUOUS = {'test', 'time', 'true', 'false', 'command', 'alias', 'type', 'source', '.'}

def first_token(s):
    s = s.lstrip()
    if s.startswith('$ '):
        s = s[2:]
    m = re.match(r'[A-Za-z0-9_./~-]+', s)
    return m.group(0) if m else None

def is_shell_line(s, strict=False):
    if not s or s.startswith('#'):
        return False
    if s[0] in '([{|!&<>;':
        return True
    if s.startswith('./') or s.startswith('~/') or s.startswith('/'):
        return True
    if re.match(r'^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=', s):
        return True
    ft = first_token(s)
    if not ft:
        return False
    if ft in AMBIGUOUS:
        return not strict
    if ft in COMMANDS:
        if strict and not ft[0].islower():
            return False
        return True
    return False

nonblank = [s for s in cleaned if s and not s.startswith('#')]
shell_mode = False
if nonblank and all(is_shell_line(s, strict=True) for s in nonblank):
    shell_mode = True

if shell_mode:
    tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile('w', suffix='.sh', delete=False)
    tmp.write('\n'.join(cleaned) + '\n')
    tmp.close()
    subprocess.run(['bash', tmp.name], check=False)
    os.unlink(tmp.name)
    sys.exit(0)

def run_shell(cmd):
    if not cmd:
        return
    if re.search(r'\bmkfs\.', cmd):
        return
    if re.search(r'\bdd\s+of=/dev/', cmd):
        return
    if re.search(r':\(\)\s*\{', cmd):
        return
    if re.search(r'>\s*/dev/sd[a-z]', cmd):
        return
    if re.search(r"\brm\s+(-[a-zA-Z]+\s+)*[\"']?/\*?[\"']?(?:$|[|;&])", cmd):
        return
    subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, executable='/bin/bash', check=False)

def resolve(p):
    p = str(p).strip()
    if not p:
        return os.getcwd()
    if p.startswith('~'):
        p = os.path.expanduser(p)
    if not os.path.isabs(p):
        p = os.path.abspath(p)
    return p

def parse_quoted_string(s):
    s = s.strip()
    if not s:
        return s
    if s[0] in QUOTES:
        if s[0] == '`':
            end = s.find('`', 1)
            if end == -1:
                return s.strip('`')
            return s[1:end]
        if s[0] == '"':
            i = 1
            buf = []
            while i < len(s):
                if s[i] == '\\' and i + 1 < len(s):
                    esc = s[i + 1]
                    buf.append({'n': '\n', 't': '\t', 'r': '\r', '\\': '\\', '"': '"', "'": "'"}.get(esc, esc))
                    i += 2
                elif s[i] == '"':
                    break
                else:
                    buf.append(s[i])
                    i += 1
            return ''.join(buf)
        if s[0] == "'":
            end = s.find("'", 1)
            if end == -1:
                return s.strip("'")
            return s[1:end]
    s = s.strip().strip(' ,;:')
    if s.endswith('.') and not re.search(r'\.\d+$', s):
        s = s[:-1]
    return s

def parse_path_token(s):
    s = s.strip()
    if not s:
        return s
    if s[0] in QUOTES:
        return parse_quoted_string(s)
    s = s.strip(' ,;:.')
    if not s:
        return s
    if re.search(r'\s', s):
        m = re.match(r'(`[^`]+`|"[^"]+"|\'[^\']+\'|/[\w./-]*|~/[\w./-]*|\.?/[\w./-]*|[\w.-]+\.[\w]+|[\w.-]+)', s)
        if m:
            return parse_path_token(m.group(1))
    return s

VERB_RE = re.compile(r'^(?:create|creates|created|make|makes|made|add|adds|added|new|touch|touches|touched|write|writes|written|append|appends|appended|delete|deletes|deleted|remove|removes|removed|erase|erases|erased|unlink|unlinks|unlinked|clear|clears|cleared|move|moves|moved|rename|renames|renamed|copy|copies|copied|cp|set|sets|change|changes|changed|install|installs|installed|compress|compresses|compressed|extract|extracts|extracted|uncompress|uncompresses|uncompressed|decompress|decompresses|decompressed|unzip|unzips|unzipped|list|lists|listed|show|shows|shown|display|displays|displayed|print|prints|printed|cat|cats|catted|run|runs|ran|execute|executes|executed|perform|performs|performed|call|calls|called|launch|launches|launched|invoke|invokes|invoked|git)\b[\s,;:]*', re.I)
QUAL_RE = re.compile(r'^(?:the|a|an|this|that|these|those|file|files|directory|directories|folder|folders|path|paths|new|old|named|called|with|at|in|on|of|for|to|which|it|from)\b[\s,;:]*', re.I)

def extract_single_path(s):
    s = s.strip()
    if not s:
        return None
    nm = re.search(r'\b(?:named|called|with name)\s*', s, re.I)
    if nm:
        s = s[nm.end():].strip()
    prev = None
    while prev != s:
        prev = s
        m = VERB_RE.match(s)
        if m:
            s = s[m.end():].strip(' ,;:')
            continue
        m = QUAL_RE.match(s)
        if m:
            s = s[m.end():].strip(' ,;:')
            continue
        break
    if not s:
        return None
    if s[0] in QUOTES:
        return parse_quoted_string(s)
    tokens = re.findall(r'`[^`]+`|"[^"]+"|\'[^\']+\'|/[\w./-]+|~/[\w./-]+|\.?/[\w./-]+|[\w.-]+\.[\w]+|[\w.-]+', s)
    best = None
    for t in tokens:
        pt = parse_path_token(t)
        if not pt:
            continue
        if best is None:
            best = pt
        if pt.startswith(('/', '~')) or '/' in pt or re.search(r'\.\w+$', pt):
            best = pt
            break
    if best:
        return best
    m = re.match(r'[^,;:\s]+', s)
    return m.group(0).strip(' ,;:.') if m else None

def extract_paths(s):
    s = s.strip()
    if not s:
        return []
    parts = re.split(r',|\s+and\s+|\s+or\s+', s, flags=re.I)
    paths = []
    for p in parts:
        pt = extract_single_path(p)
        if pt:
            paths.append(pt)
    if not paths:
        pt = extract_single_path(s)
        if pt:
            paths = [pt]
    return paths

def apply_location(s, path):
    if path is None:
        return path
    if os.path.isabs(path) or path.startswith('~'):
        return path
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:in|at|under|inside|within)\s+(?P<loc>.+?)(?=\s+and\b|\s*,|\s+named\b|\s+called\b|[,.]|$)', s, re.I)
    if m:
        loc = extract_single_path(m.group('loc'))
        if loc and re.match(r'^[/~.]|/|\.\w+$|[\w-]+$', loc):
            return os.path.join(loc, path)
    return path

def write_file(path, content, mode='w'):
    if not path:
        return
    p = resolve(path)
    d = os.path.dirname(p)
    if d:
        os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
    with open(p, mode, encoding='utf-8') as f:
        if content is not None:
            f.write(content)

def extract_content(s):
    s = s.strip()
    if not s:
        return None
    if s[0] in QUOTES:
        return parse_quoted_string(s)
    q = re.compile(r'^(?:the|a|an|this|that|these|those|following|new|old|string|text|message|content|line|data|value|phrase|sentence|file|files|document|documents)\b[\s,;:]*', re.I)
    prev = None
    while prev != s:
        prev = s
        m = q.match(s)
        if m:
            s = s[m.end():].strip(' ,;:')
        else:
            break
    if not s:
        return None
    m = re.search(r'`[^`]+`|"[^"]+"|\'[^\']+\'', s)
    if m:
        return parse_quoted_string(m.group(0))
    s = s.strip(' ,;:')
    if s.endswith('.') and not re.search(r'\.\d+$', s):
        s = s[:-1]
    return s

def handle_run(s):
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:run|execute|perform|call|launch|invoke)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:command\s+|following\s+|script\s+|program\s+|task\s+)?(?P<cmd>.+)$', s, re.I)
    if not m:
        return False
    c = m.group('cmd').strip().strip(' .,')
    if not c:
        return False
    pr = resolve(c)
    if os.path.exists(pr):
        if pr.endswith('.sh'):
            run_shell('bash ' + shlex.quote(pr))
        else:
            try:
                os.chmod(pr, os.stat(pr).st_mode | 0o111)
            except OSError:
                pass
            subprocess.run([pr], check=False)
        return True
    if is_shell_line(c, strict=False) or (c.split() and c.split()[0] in COMMANDS):
        run_shell(c)
        return True
    return False

def handle_git(s):
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:initialize|init|create|make|set up|setup)\s+(?:a\s+)?git\s*(?:repository|repo)\b(?:\s+(?:in|at|inside|under|to|the)\s+(?P<dir>.+))?', s, re.I)
    if m:
        d = m.group('dir') or '.'
        d = extract_single_path(d) or '.'
        run_shell('git init ' + shlex.quote(resolve(d)))
        return True
    m = re.search(r'\bcommit\s+all\s+changes?\s*(?:with\s+(?:the\s+)?message\s*)?(?P<msg>.+)$', s, re.I)
    if m:
        msg = extract_content(m.group('msg'))
        if msg is None:
            msg = m.group('msg').strip().strip(' .,')
        run_shell('git add -A && git commit -m ' + shlex.quote(msg) + ' || true')
        return True
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:create|make|check out|checkout|switch to)\s+(?:a\s+)?(?:git\s+)?branch\s+(?P<branch>.+)$', s, re.I)
    if m:
        branch = extract_single_path(m.group('branch')) or m.group('branch').strip(' .,')
        run_shell('git checkout -b ' + shlex.quote(branch) + ' || true')
        return True
    return False

def handle_write(s):
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:write|append|add|put|place|print|echo)\s+(?P<content>.+?)\s+to\s+(?P<path>.+)$', s, re.I)
    if m:
        path = extract_single_path(m.group('path'))
        content = extract_content(m.group('content'))
        if path:
            mode = 'a' if re.search(r'\b(?:append|add)\b', s, re.I) else 'w'
            write_file(path, content if content is not None else '', mode)
            return True
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:write|append|add|put|place|print|echo)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:string|text|message|content|line|data|value|following)?\s*to\s+(?P<path>.+?)\s+(?P<content>.+)$', s, re.I)
    if m:
        path = extract_single_path(m.group('path'))
        content = extract_content(m.group('content'))
        if path:
            mode = 'a' if re.search(r'\b(?:append|add)\b', s, re.I) else 'w'
            write_file(path, content if content is not None else '', mode)
            return True
    return False

def handle_create_file(s):
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:create|make|add|new|touch)\b.*?\b(?:file|files|document|documents|text file|plain text file|plain file|txt)\b', s, re.I)
    if not m:
        return False
    suffix = s[m.end():]
    path = extract_single_path(suffix)
    if not path:
        return False
    path = apply_location(suffix, path)
    content = None
    c = re.search(r'\b(?:with|containing|that contains?|whose content is?|has|should contain)\b', suffix, re.I)
    if c:
        content = extract_content(suffix[c.end():])
    write_file(path, content if content is not None else '', 'w')
    return True

def handle_create_dir(s):
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:create|make|add|new)\b.*?\b(?:directories?|dirs?|folders?|subdirectories?|subdirs?)\b', s, re.I)
    if not m:
        return False
    suffix = s[m.end():]
    paths = extract_paths(suffix)
    if not paths:
        one = extract_single_path(suffix)
        if one:
            paths = [one]
    for p in paths:
        p2 = apply_location(suffix, p)
        if p2:
            os.makedirs(resolve(p2), exist_ok=True)
    return True

def handle_text_ops(s):
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:remove|delete)\s+(?:all\s+|the\s+)?(?:duplicate\s+)?duplicates?\s+(?:from\s+|in\s+|in the file\s+|in the files\s+)?(?P<path>.+)$', s, re.I)
    if m:
        p = extract_single_path(m.group('path'))
        if p:
            pr = resolve(p)
            run_shell('sort -u ' + shlex.quote(pr) + ' -o ' + shlex.quote(pr))
            return True
    m = re.search(r'\bsort\s+(?:the\s+)?file\s+(?P<path>.+?)(?:\s+in\s+place)?$', s, re.I)
    if not m:
        m = re.search(r'\bsort\s+(?P<path>.+?)\s+in\s+place$', s, re.I)
    if m:
        p = extract_single_path(m.group('path'))
        if p:
            pr = resolve(p)
            run_shell('sort ' + shlex.quote(pr) + ' -o ' + shlex.quote(pr))
            return True
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:remove|delete)\s+(?:all\s+|the\s+)?empty\s+lines?\s+(?:from\s+|in\s+)?(?P<path>.+)$', s, re.I)
    if m:
        p = extract_single_path(m.group('path'))
        if p:
            pr = resolve(p)
            tmp = pr + '.tmp'
            run_shell("grep -v '^[[:space:]]*$' " + shlex.quote(pr) + ' > ' + shlex.quote(tmp) + ' && mv ' + shlex.quote(tmp) + ' ' + shlex.quote(pr))
            return True
    m = re.search(r'\bconvert\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+)?(?P<path>.+?)\s+to\s+(?P<case>lowercase|uppercase)\b', s, re.I)
    if m:
        p = extract_single_path(m.group('path'))
        if p:
            pr = resolve(p)
            tmp = pr + '.tmp'
            if m.group('case').lower() == 'lowercase':
                trset = 'upper-lower'
            else:
                trset = 'lower-upper'
            run_shell('tr ' + shlex.quote(trset) + ' < ' + shlex.quote(pr) + ' > ' + shlex.quote(tmp) + ' && mv ' + shlex.quote(tmp) + ' ' + shlex.quote(pr))
            return True
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:replace|substitute)\s+(?P<old>.+?)\s+with\s+(?P<new>.+?)\s+in\s+(?P<path>.+)$', s, re.I)
    if m:
        old = extract_content(m.group('old'))
        new = extract_content(m.group('new'))
        p = extract_single_path(m.group('path'))
        if old is not None and new is not None and p:
            pr = resolve(p)
            with open(pr, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
                data = f.read()
            data = data.replace(old, new)
            with open(pr, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                f.write(data)
            return True
    return False

def handle_symlink(s):
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:create|make|add|link)\s+(?:a\s+)?(?:symbolic\s+)?(?:link|symlink)\s*(?:from\s+)?(?P<target>.+?)\s+to\s+(?P<link>.+)$', s, re.I)
    if m:
        target = extract_single_path(m.group('target'))
        link = extract_single_path(m.group('link'))
        if target and link:
            t = resolve(target)
            l = resolve(link)
            d = os.path.dirname(l)
            if d:
                os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
            if os.path.exists(l) or os.path.islink(l):
                try:
                    os.remove(l)
                except OSError:
                    pass
            os.symlink(t, l)
            return True
    return False

def handle_copy(s):
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:copy|cp)\s+(?P<src>.+?)\s+to\s+(?P<dst>.+)$', s, re.I)
    if not m:
        return False
    src = extract_single_path(m.group('src'))
    dst = extract_single_path(m.group('dst'))
    if not src or not dst:
        return False
    srcp = resolve(src)
    dstp = resolve(dst)
    if os.path.isdir(dstp):
        dstp = os.path.join(dstp, os.path.basename(srcp))
    d = os.path.dirname(dstp)
    if d:
        os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
    if os.path.isdir(srcp):
        shutil.copytree(srcp, dstp, dirs_exist_ok=True)
    else:
        shutil.copy2(srcp, dstp)
    return True

def handle_move(s):
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:move|rename|mv)\s+(?P<src>.+?)\s+to\s+(?P<dst>.+)$', s, re.I)
    if not m:
        return False
    src = extract_single_path(m.group('src'))
    dst = extract_single_path(m.group('dst'))
    if not src or not dst:
        return False
    srcp = resolve(src)
    dstp = resolve(dst)
    if os.path.isdir(dstp):
        dstp = os.path.join(dstp, os.path.basename(srcp))
    d = os.path.dirname(dstp)
    if d:
        os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.move(srcp, dstp)
    return True

def handle_permissions(s):
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:set|change|make|chmod)\s+(?:the\s+)?permissions?\s+(?:of\s+|on\s+|for\s+)?(?P<path>.+?)\s*(?:to|as)?\s*(?P<mode>[0-7]{3,4})\b', s, re.I)
    if not m:
        m = re.search(r'\bchmod\s+(?P<mode>[0-7]{3,4})\s+(?P<path>.+)$', s, re.I)
    if not m:
        return False
    path = extract_single_path(m.group('path'))
    mode = m.group('mode')
    if not path or not mode:
        return False
    pr = resolve(path)
    os.chmod(pr, int(mode, 8))
    return True

def parse_packages(s):
    s = s.strip().strip(' .,')
    parts = re.split(r',|\s+and\s+|\s+or\s+', s, flags=re.I)
    bad = {'package', 'packages', 'pkg', 'pkgs', 'named', 'called', 'the', 'a', 'an', 'application', 'applications', 'program', 'programs', 'software', 'for', 'in', 'on', 'with'}
    out = []
    for p in parts:
        p = p.strip().strip(' .,')
        if not p:
            continue
        for tok in re.findall(r'`[^`]+`|"[^"]+"|\'[^\']+\'|[\w.-]+', p):
            t = parse_quoted_string(tok)
            if t and t.lower() not in bad:
                out.append(t)
    return out

def handle_install(s):
    m = re.search(r'\binstall\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:packages?|pkgs?|applications?|programs?|software)?\s*(?:named\s+|called\s+)?(?P<pkgs>.+)$', s, re.I)
    if not m:
        return False
    pkgs = parse_packages(m.group('pkgs'))
    if not pkgs:
        return False
    prefix = ''
    if os.geteuid() != 0:
        prefix = 'sudo ' if os.path.exists('/usr/bin/sudo') or os.path.exists('/usr/sbin/sudo') else ''
    cmd = prefix + 'apt-get install -y ' + ' '.join(shlex.quote(p) for p in pkgs)
    p = subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, executable='/bin/bash', check=False)
    if p.returncode != 0:
        subprocess.run(prefix + 'apt-get update', shell=True, executable='/bin/bash', check=False)
        subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, executable='/bin/bash', check=False)
    return True

def handle_compress(s):
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:compress|archive|gz|gzip|tar|zip)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:file|directory|folder|data|content)?\s*(?P<path>.+)$', s, re.I)
    if not m:
        return False
    p = extract_single_path(m.group('path'))
    if not p:
        return False
    pr = resolve(p)
    verb = m.group(0).strip().split()[0].lower()
    if os.path.isdir(pr):
        abspr = os.path.abspath(pr)
        name = os.path.basename(abspr) or 'dir'
        parent = os.path.dirname(abspr) or '.'
        archive = os.path.join(parent, name + '.tar.gz')
        run_shell('tar -czf ' + shlex.quote(archive) + ' -C ' + shlex.quote(parent) + ' ' + shlex.quote(name))
    elif verb == 'zip' and not pr.endswith('.zip'):
        archive = pr + '.zip'
        run_shell('python3 -m zipfile -c ' + shlex.quote(archive) + ' ' + shlex.quote(pr))
    else:
        if not pr.endswith('.gz'):
            run_shell('gzip -k ' + shlex.quote(pr))
    return True

def handle_extract(s):
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:extract|uncompress|decompress|unzip|untar|unpack|gunzip)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:file|archive|gz|zip|tar)?\s*(?P<path>.+)$', s, re.I)
    if not m:
        return False
    p = extract_single_path(m.group('path'))
    if not p:
        return False
    pr = resolve(p)
    dest = os.path.dirname(pr) or '.'
    if pr.endswith(('.tar.gz', '.tgz')):
        run_shell('tar -xzf ' + shlex.quote(pr) + ' -C ' + shlex.quote(dest))
    elif pr.endswith('.tar.bz2'):
        run_shell('tar -xjf ' + shlex.quote(pr) + ' -C ' + shlex.quote(dest))
    elif pr.endswith('.tar.xz'):
        run_shell('tar -xJf ' + shlex.quote(pr) + ' -C ' + shlex.quote(dest))
    elif pr.endswith('.zip'):
        run_shell('python3 -m zipfile -e ' + shlex.quote(pr) + ' ' + shlex.quote(dest))
    elif pr.endswith('.gz'):
        run_shell('gunzip -k ' + shlex.quote(pr))
    elif pr.endswith('.tar'):
        run_shell('tar -xf ' + shlex.quote(pr) + ' -C ' + shlex.quote(dest))
    else:
        run_shell('tar -xf ' + shlex.quote(pr) + ' -C ' + shlex.quote(dest))
    return True

def handle_show(s):
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:show|display|print|list|cat)\s+(?:the\s+|all\s+|every\s+)?(?:files?|contents?|content|directory|folder|dir|listing)\s*(?:in\s+|of\s+|from\s+|under\s+)?(?P<path>.+)$', s, re.I)
    if m:
        p = extract_single_path(m.group('path'))
        if p:
            pr = resolve(p)
            if os.path.isdir(pr):
                run_shell('ls -A ' + shlex.quote(pr))
            else:
